request.prompt: Images 1-4 are reference photos of the masked person; match the mask shape, colour and headphones exactly. Black-and-white high-key 35mm film photograph, overexposed and airy, blown-out whites, heavy film grain, faint photocopy halftone texture, slight softness, editorial fashion photography. Everything is monochrome grey EXCEPT the mask, which keeps exactly its soft light mint-green paper colour from the reference images (do not saturate or brighten it) — the only colour in the picture. Lots of empty white negative space. Compose for a 16:9 crop. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Medium shot, frontal, slightly low angle, in an empty white space: the masked person EXACTLY as in the reference images — copy the mask shape faithfully: a soft light mint-green crumpled-paper Pac-Man ghost mask, its silhouette is a pixel ghost with a stepped rounded dome top, straight sides and a pixel zigzag bottom edge, with some thickness but NOT a cube or box or cylinder; two black plus-sign eyes on the front; chunky faceted off-white pixel-block headphones with a stepped pixel headband over the dome and a thin black boom microphone from the right ear cup; oversized beige hoodie, black trousers. The mask face and the body ALWAYS face the same direction, toward the camera. The mask is long enough to reach down to the hoodie collar: no chin, no jaw, no skin of the face visible anywhere throws his head back with both hands pressing the headphones to his head, lost in the music, shoulders up, chest open, natural candid moment like a real concert photo, not posed.
